releaseNotes.text: More space for reading with a smaller floating panel. Removed the Ready/Preparing row and moving progress bar; loading stays inside the main playback button. A small Tt icon beside skip-forward switches between text and the original page. Performance info remains optional and your show/hide choice is saved. Controls keep their position during audio preparation.

en-US.title: Read Assist
en-US.fullDescription: Read Assist turns your documents into audio you can listen to anywhere. Open a document or scan a page, and Read Assist reads it aloud with natural on-device voices. Text recognition and speech are processed entirely on your device, so your documents never leave your phone. No account, no ads, and it works offline. Free to download with all features free.
en-US.shortDescription: Read documents aloud — scan, OCR and listen, fully on-device.

requestedListing.title: Read Assist
requestedListing.fullDescription:
Make space for a good read. Read Assist brings your PDFs, scanned pages, images and saved web articles into one reading library.

READ AND LISTEN
Switch between the original PDF and a clear text view. Turn pages with a book-style swipe, follow highlighted words as you listen, and pause, skip or change playback speed from the reader controls.

MAKE READING COMFORTABLE
Adjust reader brightness and add a warm light overlay. Choose a reading font and text size, then pick the Warm Library, Modern Focus or Night Reader app theme.

LOOK UP WORDS WITHOUT LEAVING THE PAGE
Open the English dictionary from your reading session. Download the dictionary pack once to look up words offline. Definitions include source attribution and links to English Wiktionary.

KEEP USEFUL CONTROLS CLOSE
Swipe up from the bottom of the reader to reach voice selection, speech processing effort, recognition settings, reading speed and lighting controls. Reading positions are saved so you can return to your documents.

PROCESS DOCUMENTS ON YOUR DEVICE
Speech generation and document processing run on your device. Voice, recognition and dictionary packs may need an initial internet download; downloaded packs can then be used offline. Opening web articles and external links requires internet access. Recognition accuracy and speech performance depend on the document, selected model and device.

All existing reading features are available without a subscription or required payment. Optional creator support does not unlock features. Optional crash reporting is off by default.

Read Assist currently supports ARM64 phones and tablets running Android 15 or later.

Support: xperimenting.ai@gmail.com
Privacy: https://sainadh812.github.io/ReadFlow/privacy.html
